intro: Venezuela has about 28 million people, though millions more have left.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Venezuelans are of mixed European, Indigenous and African descent. Spanish is official. Most people are Catholic.
Nearly eight million Venezuelans have moved abroad, especially to Colombia, Peru, Brazil, Chile and the United States.

chapters.title: Caracas
text: Caracas, the capital, lies in a valley below Mount Ávila.

keyTerms.meaning: Leaving your country to live elsewhere.
